def try_eval(expr_name, f):
    try:
        val = f()
        mp_val = val
        # normalize to plain Python types when possible
        if isinstance(val, mp.mpf):
            out = float(val) if val == float(val) else str(val)
        else:

        probe(expr_name, out)
